edges.reason: block.timestamp is read in runPicker and stored in blockTimeStamp to act as the picker seed

the predictable index selects the participant whose addressToTokenIds list receives the token id

normalization_plan.reason: _BTS is only used as the seed argument of randomNum and carries no independent semantics
_tokenId is a purely local hash input of randomNum and should be folded into that function node
_ad is only the lookup key of the allowance getter and can be merged with it
index is the sole argument controlling the internal remove() shifting logic
newOwner is the value written into _owner by the internal ownership transfer
local random is a transient index computed and consumed entirely inside runPicker
local num is the intermediate modulo result returned by randomNum and has no standalone meaning
oldOwner is a temporary cache used only while emitting the ownership event
local results is the return buffer built and returned entirely inside getResults
